* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Character: Wyron Serper, Hoth, U2
|strategy=By [mailto:cconnors@net1plus.com Chris Connors]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/light/small/wyronserper.html</ref>

This sensor specialist has some annoying abilities, enhanced by the fact that he is a spy! Knowing what the opponent is up to is never a bad thing, so if you park him at a 2/2 site he can look at two random cards

to plan your deployment a bit easier. Then if some opposing characters come to visit, you can send him [[Undercover]] to block the drain.

His destiny adding ability operates with cards that have the full word "scan" in the title, and as per the Current Rulings entry for "title", that only works with cards like "[[Perimeter Scan]]", not cards that say "Scanner".

Try keying off his "spy" ability with cards like Soth Petitkkin, [[Double Agent]] and [[Sabotage]].
|combos=* [[Wyron Serper]] + [[Double Agent]]<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Wyron%20Serper</ref>
